key_highlights: ASX records fourth consecutive losing week as rising bond yields pressure equities across sectors
RBA signals continued rate hikes despite surging unemployment, creating a stagflationary 'interest rate pincer' for households
AUD experiences sharp depreciation ('trapdoor'), raising import costs and pressuring resource exporters
Australian house prices over halfway to largest 40-year correction, with Victoria hit hardest on unemployment
Mining exploration active: gold (Aurum 155g/t, Zenith WA corridor, Auric Munda) and copper (Rio2 Peru) drilling progress
$2.7B in small-cap cap raises flooding ASX, testing investor appetite for dilution
Geopolitical escalation: Ukraine-Russia drone strikes and China-US tensions add risk premium

sectors.trend: Exploration activity robust across gold and copper; small-cap cap raises ($2.7B) signal capital hunger but dilution risk. Rio2 (RIO2.AX) Peruvian copper drill and WA gold hits (Zenith, Auric) support sector sentiment despite broad market weakness.
sectors.implications: Gold miners benefit from safe-haven flows amid geopolitical risk; copper names gain on energy-transition demand. Large caps (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) pressured by AUD weakness and China demand uncertainty.

sectors.trend: RBA hawkish stance supports NIMs but rising unemployment threatens credit quality. Intergenerational Report 2026 flags fiscal pressure. Renters' financial stress (50%+) signals consumer credit risk.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin tailwinds from higher rates but rising NPLs from housing correction and unemployment. Defensive positioning warranted.

sectors.trend: Data centre boom driving electricity demand but straining grid capacity ('energy bust'). Energy security becomes a policy priority.
sectors.implications: Energy generators (AGL.AX, CGP.AX, INC.AX) benefit from structural demand growth; grid infrastructure names gain policy support.

sectors.trend: Household squeeze intensifies: interest rate pincer, housing correction, renter stress. Healthcare (CSL.AX) remains defensive anchor. Consumer staples under pressure from weak demand.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WBC.AX (consumer) face margin pressure; CSL.AX, SGH.AX offer relative safety. EV adoption (Bentley $325k) signals slow consumer transition.

sectors.trend: Housing correction (largest in 40 years) and rising yields create headwinds for residential REITs. Commercial property (CBD tower sale at $40m) shows distress.
sectors.implications: Residential REITs (GPW.AX, LPT.AX) under pressure; office REITs face structural oversupply. Selective value in industrial/growth REITs.

sectors.trend: US AI chip race intensifies (AMD, Nvidia, Lumentum, Zscaler). Australian small-caps (Micro-X, Mamba) ride global AI sentiment. Data centre energy demand links to local utilities.
sectors.implications: ASX tech names remain illiquid; global AI capex cycle supports sentiment but valuation risk elevated. Focus on earnings-verified names.

key_themes: Stagflation risk: RBA hiking into rising unemployment
Bond yield surge pressuring equity valuations across ASX
AUD depreciation as import-cost and resource-export wildcard
Housing correction deepening with 40-year high drawdown
Mining exploration momentum (gold/copper) vs. small-cap dilution flood
Energy demand structural shift from data centres

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA stagflationary policy: hiking into unemployment surge
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight rate-sensitive defensives (CSL.AX, WES.AX); underweight rate-sensitive growth and REITs; monitor RBA statement for pivot signals
Hedge AUD exposure; favour domestic-revenue earners; resource exporters (BHP.AX, RIO.AX) benefit from weaker AUD but face China demand risk
Reduce residential REIT and construction exposure; monitor bank NPL data; favour industrial/growth REITs
Maintain 10-15% gold allocation (GSG.AX, NVG.AX); diversify away from single-commodity exposure
Avoid pre-announcement small-cap positions; favour ASX 200 liquidity; scrutinise use-of-proceeds before participating

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Bond yield spike triggering equity de-rating
risk_assessment.mitigation: Shorten duration in fixed income; favour short-duration credit; monitor 10-yr GBA yield vs. equity earnings yield spread

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners on safe-haven and AUD-weakness tailwind
opportunities.rationale: Geopolitical risk, AUD depreciation, and strong exploration results (Aurum, Zenith, Auric) support gold sector; GSG.AX and NVG.AX offer liquidity

opportunities.recommendation: Selective copper exposure via Rio2 and large-cap miners
opportunities.rationale: Rio2 Peruvian drill assault and global energy-transition demand support copper; BHP.AX and FMG.AX benefit from AUD weakness on USD-priced commodities

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy generators on data-centre demand structural tailwind
opportunities.rationale: Data centre boom creates multi-year electricity demand; AGL.AX and CGP.AX positioned for volume growth and policy support

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive healthcare and consumer staples allocation
opportunities.rationale: Stagflation environment favours rate-insensitive, essential-demand names; CSL.AX and WES.AX provide portfolio stability

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce residential REIT and construction exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: 40-year housing correction, rising yields, and renter stress create sustained headwinds for property-linked equities

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge equity portfolio with short-duration bonds and gold
defensive_moves.rationale: Bond yield spike risk and fourth consecutive ASX losing week signal elevated drawdown risk; gold hedges geopolitical and currency risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid undifferentiated small-cap mining cap raises
defensive_moves.rationale: $2.7B dilution flood without proportional discovery pipeline creates value destruction risk for retail investors

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to extend weakness in 1-3 month window. RBA hawkish bias, rising bond yields, and AUD depreciation create a hostile backdrop. Fourth consecutive losing week suggests momentum is firmly negative. Expect volatility around RBA decisions and US data prints. Gold and energy names outperform; banks and REITs lag.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pivots on unemployment data. Housing correction may stabilise by mid-2027. Mining sector supported by gold/copper structural demand. Energy transition (data centres) provides multi-year growth vector. Key risk: prolonged stagflation delaying rate cuts and deepening credit stress.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and statement (stagflation pivot signal)
Australian unemployment and CPI data (next print)
AUD/USD trajectory and RBA intervention risk
Iron ore and copper price direction (China stimulus)
US Fed policy and global bond yield trajectory
Housing market bottoming signal (VHPI, corelogic data)
watch_list: 10-yr GBA yield vs. ASX earnings yield spread
RBA cash rate and forward guidance
Australian unemployment rate and participation rate
Data centre capex announcements (energy demand proxy)
